sn15.20:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati gijjhakūṭe pabbate.
sn15.20:2.2: pubbā koṭi na paññāyati avijjānīvaraṇānaṃ sattānaṃ taṇhā saññojanānaṃ sandhāvataṃ saṃsarataṃ.
sn15.20:2.3: bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave imassa vepul lassa pabbatassa pācīnavaṃsotveva samaññā udapādi.
sn15.20:2.4: tena kho pana bhikkhave samayena manussānaṃ tivarātveva samaññā udapādi.
sn15.20:2.5: tivarānaṃ bhikkhave manussānaṃ cattāḷīsavassasahassāni āyuppamāṇaṃ ahosi.
sn15.20:2.6: tivarā bhikkhave manussā pācīnavaṃsaṃ pabbataṃ catūhena ārohanti catūhena orohanti.
sn15.20:2.7: tena kho pana bhikkhave samayena kakusandho bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho loke uppanno hoti.
sn15.20:2.8: kakusandhassa bhikkhave bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa vidhūrasañjīvan nāma sāvakayugaṃ ahosi aggaṃ bhaddayugaṃ.
sn15.20:2.9: passatha bhikkhave sā cevimassa pabbatassa samaññā antarahitā te ca manussā kāla katā so ca bhagavā parinibbuto.
sn15.20:2.13: yāvañcidaṃ bhikkhave alameva sabbasaṅkhāresu nibbindituṃ alaṃ virajjituṃ alaṃ vimuccituṃ.
sn15.20:3.1: bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave imassa vepullassa pabbatassa vaṅkato tveva samaññā udapādi.
sn15.20:3.2: tena kho pana bhikkhave samayena manussānaṃ rohitassātveva samaññā udapādi.
sn15.20:3.3: rohitassānaṃ bhikkhave manussānaṃ tiṃsavassasahassāni āyuppamāṇaṃ ahosi.
sn15.20:3.4: rohitassā bhikkhave manussā vaṅkataṃ pabbataṃ tīhena ārohanti tīhena orohanti.
sn15.20:3.5: tena kho pana bhikkhave samayena konāgamano bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho loke uppanno hoti.
sn15.20:3.6: konāgamanassa bhikkhave bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa bhiyyosuttaraṃ nāma sāvakayugaṃ ahosi aggaṃ bhaddayugaṃ.
sn15.20:3.7: passatha bhikkhave sā cevimassa pabbatassa samaññā antarahitā te ca manussā kālakatā so ca bhagavā pari nibbuto.
sn15.20:4.1: bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave imassa vepullassa pabbatassa supasso tveva samaññā udapādi.
sn15.20:4.2: tena kho pana bhikkhave samayena manussānaṃ sappiyātveva samaññā udapādi.
sn15.20:4.3: suppiyānaṃ bhikkhave manussānaṃ vīsativassasahassāni āyuppamāṇaṃ ahosi.
sn15.20:4.4: suppiyā bhikkhave manussā supassaṃ pabbataṃ dvīhena ārohanti dvīhena orohanti.
sn15.20:4.5: tena kho pana bhikkhave samayena kassapo bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho loke uppanno hoti.
sn15.20:4.6: kassapassa bhikkhave bhagavato arahato sammā sambuddhassa tissa bhāradvājaṃ nāma sāvakayugaṃ ahosi aggaṃ bhaddayugaṃ.
sn15.20:4.7: passatha bhikkhave sā cevimassa pabbatassa samaññā antarahitā te ca manussā kālakatā so ca bhagavā parinibbuto.
sn15.20:5.1: etarahi kho pana bhikkhave imassa vepullassa pabbatassa vepullotveva samaññā udapādi.
sn15.20:5.2: etarahi kho pana bhikkhave imesaṃ manussānaṃ māgadhakātveva
sn15.20:5.3: bhikkhave manussānaṃ appakaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ parittakaṃ lahukaṃ
sn15.20:5.4: yo ciraṃ jīvati so vassasataṃ appaṃ vā bhiyyo vā.
sn15.20:5.5: māgadhakā bhikkhave manussā vepullaṃ pabbataṃ muhutteneva ārohanti muhuttena orohanti.
sn15.20:5.6: etarahi kho panāyaṃ bhikkhave arahaṃ sammāsambuddho loke uppanno.
sn15.20:5.7: mayhaṃ kho pana bhikkhave sāriputtamoggallānaṃ nāma sāvakayugaṃ aggaṃ bhaddayugaṃ.
sn15.20:5.8: bhavissati bhikkhave so samayo yā ayañcevimassa pabbatassa samaññā antaradhāyissati ime ca manussā kālaṃ karissanti ahañca parinibbāyissāmi.
sn15.20:5.12: yāvañcidaṃ bhikkhave alameva sabbasaṅkhāresu nibbindituṃ alaṃ virajjituṃ alaṃ vimuccitunti.
sn15.20:6.2: idaṃ vatvāna sugato athāparaṃ eta davoca satthā
